newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Indian Petro bonds AA-minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Indian Petro bonds AA-minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it has assigned an AA-minus credit rating to Indian Petrochemicals Corp Ltd's US$175 million convertible bonds.

It said the rating of the bonds, described as credit enhanced debt indexed to stock, reflects the irrevocable, direct-pay, letter of credit issued by Bank of America NT&SA that supports the payment of interest, principal and premium on the bonds.

The bank has an S&P rating of AA-minus, and any long-term rating change on Bank of America NT&SA would translate into a correpsonding rating change on the bonds due March 11, 2001, the rating agency said.
But the rating does not address the likelihood or the ability of the bonds to be converted into company shares or global depository shares, it said.

If holders elect to convert the bonds into Indian Petrochemicals shares or its global depository shares, the amount of the letter of credit may be reduced by the principal, premium and interest of the bonds tendered for conversion, S&P said.
Indian Petrochemicals is a leading Indian manufacturer of polymers, fibres, and fibre intermediates and chemical products derived from hydrocarbon feedstocks.
